claims: One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson directed One Battle After Another.
One Battle After Another is a comedy-drama about a former revolutionary searching for his daughter.
One Battle After Another won Best Director.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for One Battle After Another.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor.
Jessie Buckley won Best Supporting Actress.
One Battle After Another won a total of six Oscars.
One Battle After Another won Original Screenplay.
The 2026 Oscars took place on March 15, 2026.
